source: OutBack Power, SunSpec Map spreadsheet (MATE3 and AXS Port) and AXS Port application note
notes: Modbus TCP over the Ethernet port of the MATE3s (also the AXS Port) using SunSpec data blocks; the Modbus port is set in the MATE3s menu and defaults to 502. The manual gives no unit identifier. The map is SunSpec-style: every block starts with a model ID (DID) and a length register, and the blocks follow each other.

Addresses are zero-based register addresses. The SunSpec identifier is at 40000 and 40001; the common block (DID 1, length 65) starts at 40002; the OutBack block (DID 64110, length 420) starts at 40069 and ends at 40490. The tables of the manual number the fields from 1 starting at the DID, so the address is 40001 plus the number for the common block and 40068 plus the number for the OutBack block. The positions follow the open-source mate3 client, which reads the block chain from 40000.

The blocks of the connected devices follow the OutBack block, one after the other, in the order of the system, and the chain ends with a block with DID 65535 and length 0. Their addresses therefore depend on the devices connected, so they are not mapped: walk the chain with the DID and length registers. The manual lists these DIDs: 64111 charge controller status, 64112 charge controller configuration, 64113 FX inverter real time, 64114 FX inverter configuration, 64115 split-phase Radian real time, 64116 Radian configuration, 64117 single-phase Radian real time, 64118 FLEXnet DC real time, 64119 FLEXnet DC configuration, 64120 system control, 64255 OPTICS packet statistics, and the SunSpec inverter models 101, 102 and 103.

Values with a scale factor are the register value times 10 to the power of the scale factor register named in scale_factor (voltage -1, hour -1, time zone -2, temperature 0). Writes need the write password set first, and changes made too often can lock up the interface of the MATE3s; keep polling to about once per second.

Passwords and the write-only fields are kept as write-only strings. Spare registers are not named. The total generator run time is listed with the unit hours but described as seconds; no unit is given.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
